name: Chris
source:
The quintessential prince charming every noblewoman dreams of.
Though he comes from the marquis family and the heroine’s father is an earl, their families share a long friendship, and Chris and the heroine have been childhood friends ever since.
Known for his flawless looks and calm demeanor, Chris shocked the heroine with an unexpected confession when she pressed him about marriage.

“I’m not good with virgins… but you are one, aren’t you?”

[Translated from [url=https://mu-game.net/gakereijou/character/]the official website[/url].]
